"I want more money" is the weakest goal there is.

Kevin Trudeau explains that a vague wish goes nowhere, because you can't hit a target you don't have. He says to name exactly what you want and write it down.

He points out that wealthy people write their goals in specifics. Andrew Carnegie said he wanted to be the largest steel producer in the world, and he knew exactly what he wanted.

How specific is your biggest goal right now?

#ad #money #goals #kevintrudeau

Feeling good now doesn't mean a bottle of wine or a shopping spree.

Kevin Trudeau explains that quick fixes are only temporary and are not real good feeling. He says that at a low point, the goal isn't to feel great, it's to feel a little better.

He calls this a gradient: small steps up the scale, one at a time.

When did you last aim for a little better instead of perfect?
